newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Adelaide Maltings sees 40 pct production rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Adelaide Maltings sees 40 pct production rise.

text.p: The Adelaide Malting Co said on Tuesday its annual malt production was expected to grow more than 40 percent in the next four years from the current 60,000 metric tonnes to meet growing Asian demand.

Managing director Bill Gill said a A$4 million expansion and upgrade of the company's Adelaide premises, opened today, would be used to spearhead a major assault on the Asian market where its malt would help supply rising beer consumption.
Adelaide Malting, Australia's third largest malting company, is 75 percent owned by the family-owned Coopers Brewery.
The company urrently sells about 40,000 metric tonnes of malt into the Asian market and is the biggest malt supplier to South East Asia, the company said in a statement.
"Beer consumption is growing faster in Asia than anywhere in the world," Gill said.
With annual sales revenue of more than A$25 million, Adelaide Malting supplies malt to 17 customers in 13 countries, including major brewers with Asian-based operations.
